phrase.zh: 散开的迹象，也能透露内部的关系。
phrase.en: Scattered evidence can reveal the relationships within.

visual.zh: 浅绿玻璃气体筒从左缘伸入，内有散点，黄铜环与立柱支撑；细线跨过深绿空隙连向右侧巨大象牙感光板的模糊同心环。细排线塑造玻璃与黄铜，点描塑造环纹，黑白版保留同一布局。
visual.en: A pale-green gas tube extends from the left with scattered dots inside, held by one brass collar and vertical support. A fine line crosses a deep-green gap to diffuse concentric rings on a large ivory photographic plate. Engraved hatch models glass and brass, stipple forms rings; neutral monochrome retains the layout.

background.zh:
德拜获得1936年诺贝尔化学奖，获奖工作包括通过偶极矩、X射线以及电子在气体中的衍射研究分子结构。偶极矩描述分子正负电荷分布不均的程度；衍射是波经过物质后形成分布图样的现象。这里采用玻璃筒中散开的点与感光板上模糊的环纹，表达从气体测量中寻找结构信息的关系，是原创寓意，不是真实仪器或测量数据，也不把德拜的工作写成布拉格父子的晶体研究；短句为原创。
1936年化学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：通过偶极矩以及X射线和气体中电子衍射研究分子结构
background.en:
Debye received the 1936 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for contributions to molecular structure through dipole moments and the diffraction of X rays and electrons in gases. A dipole moment describes uneven positive and negative charge in a molecule; diffraction is the pattern produced when waves encounter matter. Scattered dots in a glass tube and diffuse rings on a photographic plate are an original metaphor for finding structure through gas measurements, not actual equipment or data. The phrase is original.
1936 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his contributions to our knowledge of molecular structure through his investigations on dipole moments and on the diffraction of X-rays and electrons in gases
